segments.an4.49:1.3: Anicce, bhikkhave, niccanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso;
segments.an4.49:1.4: dukkhe, bhikkhave, sukhanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso;
segments.an4.49:1.5: anattani, bhikkhave, attāti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso;
segments.an4.49:1.6: asubhe, bhikkhave, subhanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
segments.an4.49:1.7: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro saññāvipallāsā cittavipallāsā diṭṭhivipallāsā.
segments.an4.49:2.3: Anicce, bhikkhave, aniccanti nasaññāvipallāso nacittavipallāso nadiṭṭhivipallāso;
segments.an4.49:2.4: dukkhe, bhikkhave, dukkhanti nasaññāvipallāso nacittavipallāso nadiṭṭhivipallāso;
segments.an4.49:2.5: anattani, bhikkhave, anattāti nasaññāvipallāso nacittavipallāso nadiṭṭhivipallāso;
segments.an4.49:2.6: asubhe, bhikkhave, asubhanti nasaññāvipallāso nacittavipallāso nadiṭṭhivipallāso.
segments.an4.49:2.7: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro nasaññāvipallāsā nacittavipallāsā nadiṭṭhivipallāsā”ti.
segments.an4.49:5.3: Te imaṃ dhammaṃ [temaṃ dhammaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] pakāsenti, dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ.

lines: Navame saññāvipallāsāti saññāya vipallatthabhāvā, catasso viparītasaññāyoti attho.
Anicce, bhikkhave, niccanti saññāvipallāsoti anicce vatthusmiṃ “niccaṃ idan”ti evaṃ gahetvā uppajjanakasaññā, saññāvipallāsoti attho.
Micchādiṭṭhihatāti na kevalaṃ saññinova, saññāya viya uppajjamānāya micchādiṭṭhiyāpi hatā.
Khittacittāti te saññādiṭṭhiyo viya uppajjamānena khittena cittena samannāgatā.
Te yogayuttā mārassāti te mārassa yoge yuttā nāma honti.
Navame aniccādīni vatthūni niccantiādinā viparītato asantīti vipallāsā, saññāya vipallāso saññāvipallāso.
Evamete catunnaṃ vatthūnaṃ vasena cattāro, tesu vatthūsu saññādīnaṃ vasena dvādasa honti.
Asubhe subhanti saññācittavipallāsā sakadāgāmimaggena tanukā honti, anāgāmimaggena pahīyanti.
